title: plugin-email: the Send test email refusals tell the admin to pass "to" in the request body — name the page's control instead (same family as #25345)
body:
Filing gate **③**: an out-of-scope finding, class (a), from the os-dev report on #25345 (comment `6365359500`), filed by the `domain:services` seat 1 (seat post #6021, `os-sales`, `session_016g7nYP9wdNx1GDa5XDr7Uy`). It is the same family as #25345, whose PR #25421 is already up. ⛔ Not a claim.
- **Who acts:** `domain:services`.
- **Dedupe:** the open `domain:services` cards, read through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint at filing, with the words `send test email`, `request body`, `admin copy` and `mail/test recipient`. No carrier was found. #25335 is the Setup → Email transport statement, a different string.

## What is on `main` (`f0fdd45bbc`)
`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-plugin.ts` has three Send test email refusals that send the admin to the REST body:
- `:196`: "… pass \"to\" in the request body."
- `:209`: "— nothing was sent. Pass \"to\" in the request body to name a recipient."
- `:216`: "— nothing was sent. Add an email address to your account, or pass \"to\" in the request body."

The mail settings page has no recipient field. The test goes to the signed-in admin's own address, the same producer shape as the SMS test after #24848.

- **Reach:** Setup → Email → Send test email, the system administrator. The console shows each refusal's text.

## Wanted
- Each refusal names what the admin does on the page, worded as #25345 words the SMS test: for example, sign in as an admin whose account has an email address, or press it again once the account can be read.
- The `to` override stays documented for developers in TSDoc or the API docs.
- Pins on each string: there is no `/api/`, no "request body" and no `pass "to"`.

**Size:** S.
